measure: historical equal retained vertices, original 63 probability masses
density: finite-bin mass divided by actual edge difference; endpoint singleton bins keep their actual width
basin_mass_bounds: valley minimum plateau bins are unassigned between adjacent candidate peaks; core excludes adjacent valley plateaus, upper includes both; threshold-crossing or within 1e-7 is uncertain
pair_requirement: all adjacent major peaks must pass valley depth and minimum possible interval separation; not only one pair
scale_consensus: all three views individually supported, same major count, each ordered major peak interval has a positive-length common intersection across all three; touching endpoints alone is uncertain
finite_zero_or_insufficient_major_mass: retain explicit uncertainty reasons, never drop rows
open_tails: negative and positive masses separately, plus both nonzero; never assign width, density, center or interpret as neg5/pos5
scope: limited finite-window visible major-peak support, may contain smaller shoulders; never raw unimodality, reproduction of historical fine-grid rules, significance or physical qualification
row_handling: classify every row independently; no mean distribution; distinct T/group presence counts can overlap; inconsistent duplicate-T labels reported separately
outputs: private per-row table remains Byte; local lightweight source/plan/aggregate summary/report only
